items.claim: Zealand Pharma announced that Phase 2 ZUPREME-1 results for petrelintide had been published in The Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology and that additional data would be presented at EASD 2026 on 30 September, reporting weight reduction of up to 10.7% versus 1.7% for placebo, gastrointestinal tolerability comparable to placebo with no vomiting at the maximum effective dose, and reductions in waist circumference, hsCRP, triglycerides and pulse rate.
items.source: Zealand Pharma A/S company press release; no named individual quoted, IR contacts listed as Eric Rojas, Rachel James-Owens and Andreas Hylleberg. Read via the FinancialContent syndicated copy.

items.claim: Zealand Pharma reported that in week 39 (21-25 September) it repurchased 315,000 shares, bringing the total to 3,940,000 shares since the programme began on 7 May 2026 under a programme of up to DKK 1.3 billion running to 31 October 2026, and that it holds 4,810,842 treasury shares, about 6.72% of share capital.
items.source: Zealand Pharma A/S company announcement, with Danske Bank as lead manager

items.claim: Zealand Pharma announced that, following a share capital increase from employee warrant exercises announced on 10 September 2026, its total number of shares and voting rights as of 30 September 2026 was 71,610,005.
items.source: Zealand Pharma A/S company announcement under section 32 of the Danish Capital Markets Act
